name: lag
description: WPA table-speed lag: a firm center-ball shot from the head spot straight up the table; total path length must be 4-4.5 table lengths before rest (WPA spec sec 8). Demonstrates rolling resistance + cushion restitution calibration; sum |pos| deltas across events (straight legs) to measure.
provenance: Geometry and reference stroke speed from crates/pool-core/tests/fixtures/anchors/lag.json and tests/anchors.rs lag_travels_4_to_4_5_table_lengths: head spot (0, -TABLE_LEN/4 = -0.635), phi = pi/2, v0 = 4.5 m/s (the kernel's documented calibration point for the WPA distance window).
